2122897751448940701.en_summary: @JonahLupton notes $NVDA just did $65B of net income in Q3 with an enterprise value of $3.75 trillion. SK Hynix expected to do $65B of net income in Q4 with EV of $525 billion. Samsung expected $74B net income in Q4 with EV of $765 billion. $NVDA looks cheap against fundamentals however SK Hynix and Samsung are just as profitable yet EVs 86% and 79% smaller. Memory peak earnings not showing in numbers. If $NVDA grows revs by 85% or more next year and $AMD TPUs other ASICs add to demand, memory revenues grow at least 50-60% including HBM plus 15-20% stock buybacks in 2026 2H and 2027. Memory stocks should not trade at 2-3x 2027 EPS if hyperscaler capex holds at $1.2T to $1.6T. Quoted: $NVDA might do $450B GAAP net income next year (FY2028) market cap $3.75T so below 8.5x FY2028.
2122897751448940701.zh_summary: @JonahLupton指出$NVDA第三季淨利潤650億，企業價值3.75萬億。SK Hynix預期第四季淨利潤650億，企業價值5250億。三星預期第四季淨利潤740億，企業價值7650億。$NVDA相對基本面看起來便宜，然而SK Hynix及三星同樣盈利但企業價值小86%及79%。記憶體高峰盈利未在數字中體現。若$NVDA明年收入增長85%或更多，且$AMD、TPU及其他ASIC增加需求，記憶體收入至少增長50-60%（包括HBM），加上2026下半年及2027年15-20%股票回購。若超大規模資本支出維持1.2萬億至1.6萬億，記憶體股票不應以2-3倍2027年每股收益交易。引用：$NVDA明年（FY2028）可能實現4500億GAAP淨利潤，市值3.75萬億，因此可能低於8.5倍FY2028。
